blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image classification models often encounter objects in diverse and unpredictable contexts at test time, which may differ substantially from those seen during training. This phenomenon, termed context shift, exposes a key fragility in neural networks: when models rely on non-causal contextual cues for prediction, shifts in context can lead to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose a novel training framework to improve the robustness of convolutional neural networks under context shift. Our approach leverages spatial feature attribution to guide models toward making predictions that rely less on contextual regions and more on object-relevant features. As a first step, recognizing a theoretical limitation of existing feature attribution methods we introduce a new variant, ContrastiveCAMs, which produces more faithful attribution maps of model predictions. Building on ContrastiveCAMs, we further propose Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy (CR-CE), a modification of the standard cross-entropy loss that regularizes the model's attention by suppressing the influence of contextual regions, thereby improving robustness to context shift. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach on several medium-to-large scale datasets (Waterbirds, Spawrious, ImageNet/ImageNet-BG, Hard-ImageNet), and report consistent improvements in context-shift robustness.
blocks.zh: 图像分类模型往往在测试时遇到不同和不可预测的物体,这可能与培训时看到的大不相同。 这种现象被称为上下文变化,暴露了神经网络中的关键脆弱性:当模型依赖非原因上下文提示进行预测时,上下文变化会导致显著性能退化. 在本文中,我们提出了一个新的训练框架,以提高在环境变化下革命神经网络的稳健性. 我们的方法利用空间特征属性指导模型进行预测,这些预测较少依赖背景区域,更依赖与物体有关的特征。 作为第一步,认识到现有特征归属方法的理论局限性,我们引入了一个新的变体ContrastiveCAMs,该变体生成了更忠实的模型预测归属图. 在ContrestiveCAMs的基础上,我们进一步提出CR-CE(CR-CE),通过抑制上下文区域的影响,对标准跨上下文损失进行修改,使模型的注意力正规化,从而增强稳健性,使其转向上下文. 我们评价我们在若干中大规模数据集(水鸟、Spawrious、ImageNet/ImageNet-BG、Hard-ImageNet)上的做法的有效性,并报告在环境变化稳健性方面不断改进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The vast applications of convolutional neural networks in safety-critical domains such as medical imaging [ 38 , 33 ] , forensic investigation [ 26 ] and self-driving [ 21 ] make trustworthy and robust predictions essential for large-scale adoption.
It has been demonstrated that existing neural networks, despite achieving remarkable performance on large-scale datasets,
heavily rely on supporting context (i.e., background area within the images) to determine their predictions [ 41 , 23 , 30 ] .
This sensitivity to surrounding context can degrade performance when the same object appears in a different environment [ 46 , 15 , 3 , 4 ] , whether due to novel object-context combinations in the test data or adversaries manipulating target-agnostic regions to mislead the model.
blocks.zh:
革命神经网络在医学成像[38,33],法证调查[26]和自驾车[21]等安全关键领域的广泛应用,使得对大规模采纳的可信而有力的预测至关重要.
已经证明,现有的神经网络, 尽管取得了显著的性能 在大型数据集,
高度依赖辅助背景(即图像内的背景区域)来确定其预测[41、23、30]。
这种对周围上下文的敏感性可以在同一个对象出现在不同的环境中[46,15,3,4]时降解性能,无论是由于测试数据中的新对象-上下文组合,还是对手操纵目标-不可知区域来误导模型.

blocks.en:
We highlight this concern in Figure 1 using the Waterbirds-100 dataset [ 37 ] which only has the object-context combinations of waterbird-waterfront and landbird-land .
When a waterbird is shown in the context of land , the model predicts the class landbird with high confidence, due to the influence of the context dominating over the influence of the object.
The converse also occurs when a landbird appears in a waterfront context.
This concerning lack of robustness has been observed across safety-critical applications spanning the diagnosis of skin cancer [ 27 ] , pneumothorax [ 36 ] , as well as in the generalization capabilities of robot foundation models [ 48 ] .

当陆生鸟出现于水边时,也会发生相反的情况。
在诊断皮肤癌[27],肺炎[36],以及机器人基础模型的通缩能力[48]等安全关键应用中都观察到了这一点。

blocks.en: In this paper, we aim to improve the context robustness of convolutional neural networks by leveraging spatial feature attributions. We begin by noting a theoretical limitation of existing feature attribution methods: they permit an arbitrary constant shift applied uniformly across all output logits, which undermines their ability to provide faithful explanations. As a result, the attributed contributions from context and object regions may not accurately reflect their true influence, as they can be distorted by this constant shift. We address this limitation by proposing a new variant ContrastiveCAMs , based on a prior method, HiResCAMs [ 10 ] . We further theoretically confirm that ContrastiveCAMs provide faithful explanations to the neural networks final predictions.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们的目标是通过利用空间地物属性来提高演化神经网络的环境稳健性. 我们首先注意到现有特性归属方法的理论局限性:它们允许在所有产出日志中统一适用任意的常态转变,这削弱了它们提供忠实解释的能力。 因此,来自上下文和对象区域的可归属贡献可能无法准确反映其真实影响,因为这些贡献可能被这种不断的转变所扭曲. 我们通过提出一个新的变体ContrestiveCAMs来解决这一限制,该变体基于一种先前的方法,HiResCAMs [10]. 我们从理论上进一步证实,ContrastiveCAM为神经网络的最终预测提供了忠实的解释.

blocks.en:
To address sensitivity to context shifts, we propose a new loss function, Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy (CR-CE), which leverages the proposed feature attribution method, ContrastiveCAMs , to encourage the model to focus on the primary object by suppressing contributions from the surrounding context. This approach requires object-context segmentation during training (crucially, with no segmentation required during inference), which can be readily obtained using existing pretrained segmentation models such as SAM3 [ 5 ] and Masked AutoEncoders (MAE) [ 13 , 17 ] .
Notably, the segmentation need not be perfect.
In our experiments on the ImageNet dataset, we use MAEs to generate object-context segmentation.
Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively reduces the context contribution to model predictions and improves convolutional networks’ robustness to context shifts consistently across a broad class of datasets.
Our key contributions are summarized as follows: • We identify a theoretical limitation of existing spatial feature attribution methods that hinders explanation faithfulness.
We address this limitation by proposing a new method ContrastiveCAMs . • We propose a new loss function, Context-Regularized Cross Entropy (CR-CE), that encourages model predictions to focus on the object region rather than the context. • Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed training approach effectively attracts the focus of feature attribution towards the object region, thus enhancing context-shift robustness.
blocks.zh:

值得注意的是,分割并不需要完美。
在ImageNet数据集的实验中,我们使用MAEs来生成对象-context分解.

blocks.en: 1.1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作

blocks.en:
Class Activation Mappings (CAMs) [ 49 ] is a prominent family of methods that identify attributions of each (spatial) feature, including
GradCAM [ 39 ] , GradCAM++ [ 6 ] , Score-CAM [ 45 ] , and HiResCAM [ 10 ] . These methods typically compute feature attributions with respect to the model’s output logits, prior to the final softmax activation. However, due to the contrastive nature of the softmax function [ 28 , 31 ] , this can lead to inaccurate attributions for the post-softmax predictions. DiffGradCAM [ 31 ] shares a similar approach to ContrastiveCAMs. But it is based on GradCAM and its connection to the model’s prediction is not theoretically clear.
blocks.zh:
类活性绘图[49]是确定每个(空间)特征的归属的著名方法家族,包括:
GradCAM [39],GradCAM++ [6], Score-CAM [45],和HiResCAM [10]. 这些方法通常在最后软马克斯活化之前计算模型输出日志的特征归属。 然而,由于软马克斯函数的对比性[28,31],这可能导致后软马克斯预测的归属不准确. DiffGradCAM [31] 与ConterstiveCAM有类似的做法。 但它是基于GradCAM,它与模型预测的关联在理论上并不明确.

blocks.en:
One approach to improving robustness is through explanation-guided methods, which leverage feature attribution or saliency maps [ 40 ] to direct the model’s attention toward relevant objects and away from contextual distractions in the images [ 14 ] .
This is typically achieved by augmenting the standard cross-entropy loss with additional regularization terms that penalize discrepancies between the model’s feature attribution map and a target explanation [ 35 , 29 , 34 , 11 ] .
The regularization term of Right for the Right Reasons (RRR) [ 35 ] penalizes the gradients of log-prediction w.r.t. the irrelevant input features.
GALS [ 29 ] regularizes the Grad-CAM of the model’s predictions toward a target feature attribution map generated using training labels and auxiliary vision-language models.
The regularization term of EBL [ 34 ] penalizes the positive attributions in contextual regions of the feature attribution map.
ABNs [ 11 ] introduce an auxiliary attention module to find key regions of images to assist convolutional networks in making predictions.
In contrast, our method directly modifies the cross-entropy loss rather than introducing an additional regularization term, so that robustness to context shifts is built in intrinsically.
blocks.zh:
改进稳健性的一个方法是通过解释性指导方法,利用特征归属图或显要图[40]将模型的注意力引向相关物体并避免图像中的背景分心[14]。
这通常是通过增加标准跨度损失,加上附加规范化术语来实现的,这些术语惩罚模型特征归属图与目标解释[35、29、34、11]之间的差异。
" 正确理由权利 " (RRR)[35]的正规化术语惩罚了日志预测w.r.t.不相干输入特性的梯度。
GALS [29] 规范了该模型的Grad-CAM对使用培训标签和辅助视觉语言模型生成的目标特征归属图的预测。
EBL[34]的规范化术语惩罚了特征归属图在上下文区域的积极归属.
ABN [11] 引入了辅助关注模块来寻找图像的关键区域来协助演化网络进行预测.
相比之下,我们的方法直接改变交叉内涵的丧失,而不是引入一个额外的正规化术语,从而在内在上下文变化中建立稳健性。

blocks.en: An orthogonal approach is worst-group generalization [ 2 , 7 , 37 ] . Rather than optimizing for overall accuracy, this line of work partitions the dataset into groups defined by object-context combinations and seeks to balance performance across groups by improving the worst-performing group.
blocks.zh: 正统做法是最坏的组合概括[2、7、37]。 这一条工作线没有优化总体准确性,而是将数据集分成由对象-内容组合定义的组别,并力求通过改进表现最差的组别来平衡各组别的业绩.

blocks.en: 2 Motivation
blocks.zh: 2 动机

blocks.en:
In image classification tasks, deep neural networks make their predictions based on both the object and the context , i.e., the backgrounds in images.
It has been observed that irrelevant, or even inversely correlated, context can make a substantial contribution to the model predictions, lowering model’s confidence on correct predictions, or even overturning the prediction into incorrectness with high confidence [ 47 , 15 , 30 ] .
This reliance renders the model less robust to context shifts, such as when a trained model is deployed in a different environment, and more vulnerable to adversarial manipulation; for instance, when an attacker deliberately replaces the context with one commonly associated with other classes.
In contrast, humans are able to distinguish between key features and spurious context; where deemed necessary, they can focus on the object region, neglecting the context, so as to accurately classify the relevant object in question.
blocks.zh:
在图像分类任务中,深神经网络根据对象和上下文进行预测,即图像中的背景.
有人认为,无关紧要,甚至反相上下,环境可对模型预测作出重大贡献,降低模型对正确预测的信心,甚至以高度的信心推翻预测,使其不正确[47、15、30]。
这种依赖使得模型不太适合上下文的变化,例如训练有素的模型部署在不同的环境中,更容易被对手操纵;例如,攻击者故意将上下文取而代之的是通常与其他类有关的上下文。
相形之下,人类能够区分出关键特征和虚假上下文;在认为必要时,可以聚焦于对象区域,忽略上下文,以便准确划分相关对象.

blocks.en:
As an illustration of this issue, consider the Waterbirds dataset [ 37 ] , which consists of two classes of birds: waterbirds and landbirds .
During training, most birds appear in their natural habitat: waterbirds are present by waterfronts, whereas landbirds are present surrounded by land.
However, during testing, a context shift may occur, where a landbird (or a waterbird) appears in a waterfront context (or a land context, respectively).
Neural networks often make incorrect predictions on images with context shift.
For example, with a fine-tuned ResNet-50, the context region on average accounts for 46 % 46\% of the model’s prediction score compared to the influence from the object. Moreover, the model’s accuracy drops from 98 % 98\% for normal images down to 41 % 41\% on images with context shift, which is even worse than the random guess accuracy of 50 % 50\% .
Using HiResCAMs [ 10 ] , a member of the CAM (short for Class Activation Mapping) family that produces a heatmap highlighting the contribution from spatial locations of the image to the network output [ 49 ] , we can visualize the context’s contributions to the model prediction, see Figure 1 for example. We see that when the image context is correlated with a different class, the misleading context makes large contributions to the prediction resulting in misclassifications with high confidence.
This shows the pervasiveness of the context robustness concern, supported by broader statistics across other datasets in Table 1 .

blocks.en: 4 Learning with Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy Loss
blocks.zh: 4 用上下文规范的交叉输入损失学习

blocks.en:
We now introduce a learning framework designed to be robust to context shifts.
In particular, we propose a novel loss function, called Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy (CR-CE), which inhibits the context from contributing to the model prediction.
This regularization is guided using the feature attributions produced by ContrastiveCAMs.
blocks.zh:
我们现在引入了一个学习框架,旨在适应环境变化。
特别是,我们提出了一个新的损失函数,称为上下文规范化的CR-CE,它抑制了上下文对模型预测的贡献.
这种规范化是利用ContrastiveCAMs的特征属性指导的。

blocks.en:
To effectively regularize against context contributions during training, prior knowledge of the contextual regions in the input images is generally required. Such information can be obtained in two main ways: (i) through segmentation annotations provided by the dataset (e.g., PASCAL VOC [ 16 ] , MS-COCO [ 22 ] ), or (ii) by leveraging pretrained object detection or segmentation models (e.g., Segment Anything Model [ 5 ] , Masked AutoEncoders [ 17 ] ) to estimate bounding boxes or object masks (see experiments on ImageNet, Spawrious datasets in Section 5 ).
In practice, the first option is often unavailable or prohibitively expensive. We adopt the second approach which is more accessible, as pretrained models can provide approximate context localization with minimal effort. Note that, our framework does not require precise object segmentation or localization, and rough estimates are often sufficient to effectively regularize contextual influence.
In Appendix C.4 , we show numerical evidence for the robustness of our framework to noisy object-context segmentation.
blocks.zh:
为了有效地规范培训期间的背景贡献,一般需要在输入图像中事先了解背景区域。 此类信息可通过两种主要方式获得:(一)通过数据集提供的分块说明(例如PASCAL VOC [16],MS-COCO [22]),或(二)通过利用预先训练的物体探测或分块模型(例如分块任何模型[5],被遮住的自动编码器[17])来估计被捆绑的盒子或物体口罩(见图像网络上的实验,第5节中有害的数据集)。
在实践中,第一种选择往往是没有的,或者价格昂贵,令人望而却步。 我们采取第二种办法,比较容易获得,因为经过预先培训的模型可以尽量不费力地提供大致本地化的背景。 请注意,我们的框架并不要求精确的对象分出或本地化,粗略的估计往往足以有效地规范背景影响。

blocks.en: Despite this seemingly minor modification, the effect on model behavior is substantial. The standard cross-entropy loss implicitly encourages the context to cooperate with the object regions in making predictions. While this is beneficial when the context is consistent with the object, it can lead to an over-reliance on contextual cues and thus reduce robustness under context shift. In contrast, CR-CE explicitly penalizes excessive reliance on context, encouraging the model to base its predictions primarily on the object itself. As a result, when the context is altered or adversarially manipulated, models trained with CR-CE exhibit improved robustness.
blocks.zh: 尽管这个看似微小的修改,但对模型行为的影响是巨大的. 标准跨直径损失隐含地鼓励上下文与物体区域合作进行预测. 这虽然在上下文与目标一致时是有益的,但可能导致过度依赖上下文提示,从而降低上下文变化后的稳健性。 相比之下,CR-CE明确惩罚过度依赖上下文的行为,鼓励该模型将其预测主要基于物体本身. 因此,当环境被改变或被对手操纵时,受过CR-CE训练的模型显示出更强的稳健性.

blocks.en: Further, for models using a linear classifier head (e.g., ResNet [ 18 ] , MobileNet [ 19 ] , EfficientNet [ 42 ] ), ContrastiveCAM can be computed in closed form, see Eqs. ( 1 ) and ( 7 ); this results in a minor computational overhead when CR-CE is used in place of cross-entropy.

blocks.en: In this section, we numerically evaluate the effectiveness of training with the proposed CR-CE loss function in both promoting object-focused learning and improving robustness to context shifts.

The test set contains combinations of dog breed and context that are not seen during training, thereby assessing models’ robustness to context shift. • ImageNet [ 8 ] with ImageNet-BG [ 30 ] as test set. We train the model using ImageNet-1k and test it using ImageNet-BG, the latter of which features images with manually replaced backgrounds, designed to decouple object recognition from context cues. • Hard-ImageNet [ 25 ] is a subset of ImageNet, consisting of 15 15 selected classes of images that have high context influence.
It is used to investigate the context’s influence on the classification by comparing the model outputs with and without the objects of the images.

blocks.en:
We observe that across all datasets, the CR-CE training framework consistently improves the robustness to context shift and further outperforms models trained using cross-entropy loss and the other compared methods.
This demonstrates that the proposed method successfully suppresses contribution from irrelevant or misleading context, yielding correct and robust model predictions.
We also note that, when the context is relevant (as in the setting without context shift), there is a slight degradation in the prediction accuracy across tasks.
This is expected because when the test dataset and training dataset have the same set of object-context combinations, the model can often infer the correct class with the help of the context.
Indeed, such correlations are often not desirable if context-shift robustness is the target.

这表明,拟议方法成功地抑制了不相关或误导性的背景,得出正确而有力的模型预测。
我们还注意到,当背景相关时(如背景无上下文变化),各项任务的预测准确性略有下降。
这是因为当测试数据集和训练数据集具有同一套对象-文本组合时,模型往往可以在上下文的帮助下推断出正确的类.
事实上,如果以环境变化的稳健性为目标,这种关联往往不可取。

blocks.en:
Additionally, we observe that some existing explanation-guided methods may underperform the standard cross-entropy baseline on complex classification tasks, such as ImageNet, while outperforming it on simpler tasks such as the Waterbirds-100 dataset.
We hypothesize that this behavior is largely due to their reliance on classical feature attribution methods (e.g. Grad-CAM and HiResCAM), which suffer from the unfaithfulness issue theoretically described in Theorem 3.2 . In the binary classification setting of Waterbirds-100, HiResCAM coincides with our ContrastiveCAMs (see Remark 3.4 ) and does not exhibit this limitation.
More discussion of explanation-guided methods on this matter can be found in
Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh:
此外,我们还注意到,一些现有的解释性指导方法可能没有很好地执行ImageNet等复杂分类任务的标准交叉输入基线,而比Waterbirds-100数据集等较简单的任务要好。
我们假设,这种行为很大程度上是由于他们依赖于古典特征的归属方法(如Grad-CAM和HiResCAM),后者在理论上受到定理3.2所描述的不忠问题. 在Waterbirds-100的二进制分类设置中,HiResCAM与我们的ContrestiveCAM(见Remark 3.4)相吻合,没有表现出这种局限性.
关于这一事项的解释性指导方法的更深入的讨论,可参见:
附录C.3

blocks.en: Notably, we emphasize that our approach does not use object-context segmentation during inference; the promising performance of our approach suggests that the CR-CE trained models have the ability to distinguish objects from context while making predictions.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,我们强调,我们的方法在推论中并不使用对象文字分解;我们方法的可喜表现表明,CR-CE训练有素的模式在预测时能够区分对象和上下文。

blocks.en: Finally, we also note that the generalization gap between in-distribution and context-shifted images shrinks as explanation granularity is increased (comparing the 7 × 7 7\times 7 and 14 × 14 14\times 14 CAM resolutions).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们还注意到,作为解释颗粒性(比较7×7 7相和14相14相14相14相14相14相14),分布中和上下文变化的图像之间的通化差距缩小了。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we advance explanation faithfulness and context robustness in convolutional networks.
We introduce ContrastiveCAMs , a feature attribution method that addresses limitations of existing CAM methods and has a strong connection to model predictions.
We further propose a new loss function, Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy (CR-CE), which penalizes contributions from context regions, thereby improving models’ robustness to context shifts.
Our experimental evaluations show that our method effectively attracts the
feature attributions towards the object region, and enhances context-shift robustness.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们推动解释在进化网络中的忠诚性和环境稳健性。
我们采用ContrestiveCAMs,一种特征归属方法,它处理现有CAM方法的局限性,并与模型预测有很强的联系.
我们进一步提出一个新的损失功能,即环境规范的跨环境功能(CR-CE),它惩罚来自环境区域的贡献,从而改进模型的稳健性,使其符合环境变化。
我们的实验评估显示 我们的方法能有效吸引
特性属性指向对象区域,并增强上下文变化的强性。

blocks.en:
We identify two limitations of this work. First, the method does not naturally extend to transformer architectures, such as Vision Transformers (ViTs) [ 9 ] . This is because CAM-based spatial feature attribution methods rely on the local structure induced by convolutional layers, whereas attention mechanisms [ 43 ] mix patch tokens in a way that loses explicit spatial locality.
Second, the proposed CR-CE training requires additional object-context segmentation information (albeit
only during training), which requires additional cost to obtain in practice. We note that existing
explanation-guided methods also rely on this information.

blocks.en: C.1 Spawrious Benchmark on Various Context-Shift Configurations

blocks.en:
The Spawrious dataset comprises of four dog breeds spread across six contexts, with three difficulty levels based on the object-context combinations available during training, and two different configurations of context shift: (i) one-to-one shifts, where each class is correlated with one context, and (ii) many-to-many shifts, where groups of classes are correlated with groups of contexts, the latter being observed broadly in practice [ 23 ] .
We include results on both one-to-one and many-to-many shifts in Table 3 .
Consistent with our findings in Section 5.3 , we observe that CR-CE trained models outperform the baseline and existing explanation-guided approaches in context-shifted accuracy across all difficulty levels.

blocks.en: C.2 Evaluating Context Dependence using Hard-ImageNet
blocks.zh: C.2 利用硬形象评估环境依赖性 净额

blocks.en:
The Hard-ImageNet benchmark [ 25 ] assesses model reliance on context by comparing performance on images with and without the target object.
Ideally, the model should predict the true class in the presence of the object, and a random class in the absence of the object.
In other words, the prediction should not be based on the context alone.
The Hard-ImageNet suite also reports Relative Foreground Sensitivity (RFS) [ 24 ] , which compares accuracy reduction when gaussian noise (with magnitude denoted ρ \rho ) is added to either the object or the context region; higher RFS signifies greater object-dependence.
blocks.zh:
难以想象 净基准 [25] 评估模型对上下文的依赖,方法是将图像的性能与目标对象和不目标对象相比较.
理想的情况是,模型应该在物体存在时预测出真实的类,在物体不存在时预测出随机的类.
换言之,预测不应仅以上下文为依据。
Hard-ImageNet套件还报告了相对前景感知(RFS)[24],该套件比较了在对象或上下文区域中加出高斯噪声(其数量表示为 $\rho)时的精度降低;更高的RFS表示更大的对象依赖性.

blocks.en: Appendix D About Data Augmentation with Object-Context Mixing
blocks.zh: 附录D 与对象- Context 混合的数据增强

blocks.en: A straightforward yet often effective approach to improving robustness to context shifts is to augment the training dataset with synthetic images that combine objects with diverse contexts [ 12 ] . This approach is orthogonal to the methods considered in this paper, including explanation-guided methods, as it leaves the training procedure unchanged and simply introduces additional augmented training samples. Therefore, it can be readily combined with our proposed method. However, its effectiveness may be limited by the finite set of object–context combinations observed during training, potentially leaving the model vulnerable to unseen context shifts at evaluation time, particularly adversarial ones. In contrast, our proposed training framework suppresses the influence of context regions, not limited by the artificial object–context combinations seen during training, potentially providing greater robustness to out-of-distribution scenarios.
blocks.zh: 一种直接但往往是有效的方法来改进环境变化的稳健性,就是用合成图像来增加培训数据集,将物体与不同背景结合起来[12]。 这种方法与本文件中考虑的方法,包括解释性指导方法是正统的,因为它使培训程序保持不变,只是引入了额外的强化培训样本。 因此,它很容易与我们提议的方法结合起来。 然而,其有效性可能受到培训期间观察到的有限对象-内容组合的限制,可能使模型在评价时易受到无法见的上下文变化的影响,特别是对抗性上下文。 相比之下,我们拟议的培训框架压制了背景区域的影响,而不受培训期间所看到的人为对象-背景组合的限制,有可能为分配外的情况提供更大的活力。

blocks.en:
We train each of our models using a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.
The most efficient loss function, cross-entropy, took a maximum of 5.5 5.5 hours to train ResNet-50 on ImageNet, and a minimum of 20 20 minutes on the Waterbirds dataset.
Training with CR-CE took a maximum of 6.1 6.1 hours per ResNet-50 run on the ImageNet dataset, and a minimum of 20 20 minutes on the Waterbirds dataset.
Each of the other methods approximately took between 8 8 and 12 12 hours to train a ResNet-50 on ImageNet.
Each of the methods used a maximum of 65 65 GB of VRAM during training on the ImageNet dataset, with gradient accumulation applied as necessary to stay within the VRAM limit of the GPU.
We trained a total of 582 582 models: 3 3 independent runs for each approach and backbone on 9 9 different training sets ( 6 6 for Spawrious, 1 1 each for Waterbirds, ImageNet-BG, and Hard-ImageNet), with 2 2 CAM resolutions for all but ABNs.
ABN increases the CAM resolution as part of its architecture design; we do not reduce it to 7 × 7 7\times 7 .
